title: Cost-augmented Schr\"odinger bridges on graphs are exactly solvable: a Feynman-Kac tilt replaces learned control
abstract: arXiv:2610.02195v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The generalized Schr\"odinger bridge on a graph moves mass between two distributions while charging a cost for the states visited. It has been approached by learning the rates of a controlled continuous-time Markov chain, with a temporal-difference penalty that restores the cost. A state cost folds into the reference process as a Feynman-Kac tilt. The cost-augmented bridge is then a plain bridge against the tilted reference, and the penalty is unnecessary. The bridge is computed exactly by alternating two endpoint rescalings, each one sparse matrix-exponential application; nothing is discretized in time or learned. The alternation converges at a rate set by the endpoint coupling alone. For a quadratic congestion cost on time-averaged occupancies, damped best response around the exact bridge is gradient descent on a strongly convex function, and its residual bounds its error. translated_title: 图上代价增广薛定谔桥可精确求解：Feynman-Kac倾斜替代学习控制
translated_abstract: 图上的广义薛定谔桥在两个分布之间迁移质量，同时对所访问的状态收取代价。以往方法通过学习受控连续时间马尔可夫链的转移速率来求解该问题，并借助时序差分惩罚来恢复代价。本文指出，状态代价可以通过 Feynman-Kac 倾斜折入参考过程。如此一来，代价增广桥就变成了相对于倾斜后参考过程的普通桥，惩罚项不再必要。该桥可以通过交替执行两次端点重缩放来精确计算，每次只需应用一次稀疏矩阵指数；整个过程无需时间离散化，也无需学习。交替迭代的收敛速率仅由端点耦合决定。对于时间平均占用上的二次拥塞代价，围绕精确桥的阻尼最优响应等价于对一个强凸函数做梯度下降，其残差可用于界定误差。在一个蛋白质折叠模型上，自由能代价降低了期望……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: 该论文的核心贡献是证明图上带状态代价的薛定谔桥可通过 Feynman-Kac 倾斜精确求解，无需学习控制或时序差分惩罚，且仅用交替端点重缩放（每次为一次稀疏矩阵指数运算）即可精确计算，并在蛋白质折叠模型上展示了自由能代价的应用。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that cost-augmented Schrödinger bridges on graphs are exactly solvable by folding state costs into the reference process via a Feynman-Kac tilt—eliminating learned control and temporal-difference penalties—and computing the bridge exactly through alternating endpoint rescalings, each requiring only a single sparse matrix-exponential application.
